absoluteIntensity.warning: Absolute MET categories do not account for individual fitness, age, disability or disease and must not override relative symptoms or perceived effort.

agePredictedHrmax.warning: Population estimate with substantial individual error; measured HRmax is preferred when safely obtained.

heartRateReserve.warning: Do not use when heart-rate response is unreliable or a clinician supplied a different target.

percentHrmax.warning: Do not present as a precise physiological threshold.
